facts.fact: Luisana Rocha, StackAdapt's VP of Client Services, says she joined the Client Services team about 4 years before the post as an Account Manager.
facts.quote: My journey started about 4 years ago when I joined the Client Services team at StackAdapt as an Account Manager.

facts.fact: As an Account Manager, Luisana Rocha worked with three different Account Executives and three portfolios spanning a wide variety of verticals.
facts.quote: I worked with three different Account Executives, and three portfolios consisting of a wide variety of verticals.

facts.fact: Luisana Rocha says she currently works with 7 Client Services Managers, each leading their own team of Account Managers, plus a Manager of Programmatic Strategy.
facts.quote: I currently work with 7 Client Services Managers, each with their own team of Account Managers, and a Manager of Programmatic Strategy

facts.fact: StackAdapt describes its Client Services team as focused on post-sales client relations and life cycle, including user adoption of the platform, regular client communications, and campaign management.
facts.quote: The Client Services team is mainly focused on post-sales client relations and life cycle as it relates to user adoption of the StackAdapt platform

facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog post on Client Services was published on March 7, 2022.
